packageRules.description: Hold jsdom at 29.x: jsdom 30 absolutizes relative lengths in getComputedStyle (2rem resolves to 32px, -0.025em to -0.4px), so every design-system toHaveStyle assertion written in rem/em fails. Revisit once those assertions stop comparing against computed style.

Hold tsdown at 0.22.x: 0.23 cannot emit declarations with TypeScript 7 ("does not provide the classic TypeScript API required by tsc") and every package build fails. Revisit once tsdown supports TypeScript 7, or the packages enable isolatedDeclarations.

Hold vike at 0.4.262: from 0.4.268 apps/docs/vite/sitemapPlugin finds no prerendered pages in its closeBundle hook, so build/client/sitemap.xml is no longer written. Revisit by emitting the sitemap in a step after the build.
Hold vike-react with vike (see the vike rule).
